annotations.title: Check AI Alert character generation status

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call. Read-only poll for a character generation started by generate_alert_character -- call it every few seconds until status is 'completed' (with a usable `path`/`url`) or 'failed' (reserved credits are returned to the wallet automatically on failure).
name: get_alert_character_status
title: Check AI Alert character generation status
